🎬 Land of Bad (2024) — Action, Thriller
Land of Bad (2024) is an intense military thriller that follows rookie Air Force combat controller Kinney as he joins an elite special operations mission in the southern Philippines. When the operation goes wrong, Kinney becomes trapped in hostile territory with limited support and must rely on the guidance of experienced Air Force drone pilot Reaper.
As the team faces overwhelming danger, the mission becomes a fight for survival. Reaper works from thousands of miles away, trying to keep Kinney and the remaining soldiers alive while navigating the limits of technology, communication, and battlefield decisions.
The film explores themes of courage, teamwork, sacrifice, leadership, and the complicated relationship between modern technology and warfare. It also shows how quickly carefully planned operations can collapse when soldiers are forced to make decisions under extreme pressure.
More than just an action movie, Land of Bad is a tense story about survival, trust, and the bond between people fighting together despite being separated by distance. 🔥
💬 Would you trust technology to guide you through a life-or-death situation? Let us know in the comments! 👇

source_details.synopsis: Land of Bad is a 2024 American action thriller film directed by William Eubank, who co-wrote the script with David Frigerio. The film stars Liam Hemsworth, Russell Crowe, Luke Hemsworth, Ricky Whittle, and Milo Ventimiglia, and follows a US Army Delta Force team on a rescue operation that comes under attack from terrorists. Land of Bad was released theatrically on February 16, 2024. It grossed $7 million worldwide.
